comment: Topic-specific management steps (NICE-based). Key = lowercase keyword match in tool title. First match wins. Specific keywords before broad.

templates.evidence: NICE NG72 (stable angina, CTCA), NG185 (acute coronary syndrome). Exclude ACS before attributing to musculoskeletal or GORD.

options.label: Stable / likely angina
options.guidance:
MANAGEMENT PLAN:
1. GTN prn; beta-blocker or CCB. Secondary prevention: aspirin, statin, ACEi if indicated.
2. Refer: Rapid Access Chest Pain Clinic for CTCA. NICE NG72.

options.label: Acute / possible ACS
options.guidance:
MANAGEMENT PLAN:
1. Emergency: 999; aspirin 300 mg if no contraindication.
2. Do not delay for troponin in primary care if typical presentation. NICE NG185.

options.label: Non-cardiac / musculoskeletal
options.guidance:
MANAGEMENT PLAN:
1. Exclude cardiac cause (ECG, troponin if indicated). Consider costochondritis, muscle strain, Tietze's; NSAID/analgesia; reassurance.
2. If GORD/reflux: trial PPI. If anxiety: support and exclude organic cause first. NICE NG72, CKS.

options.label: Safety net
options.guidance: SAFETY: Reattend if central/crushing pain, breathlessness, collapse, or pain at rest. If suspected ACS call 999. NICE NG72, NG185.

keywords: early detection of cancer in primary care

options.label: Assessment
options.guidance:
MANAGEMENT PLAN:
1. Role of multi-cancer detection tests (e.g. Galleri) is evolving. NICE and NHS are evaluating; not yet routine in UK.
2. Use existing NICE NG12 symptom-based pathways for suspected cancer. NICE CKS.

options.label: When to refer
options.guidance:
MANAGEMENT PLAN:
1. 2WW for suspected cancer per NG12. Do not replace with blood-based screening outside trials. NICE NG12.

keywords: improving consultations for children with additional needs

steps.question: Consultations for children with additional needs

options.label: Assessment
options.guidance:
MANAGEMENT PLAN:
1. Consider communication needs, sensory environment, reasonable adjustments. Involve family and carers.
2. Use clear language; allow time; avoid assumptions. NICE NG76, CKS.

options.label: Management & referral
options.guidance:
MANAGEMENT PLAN:
1. Signpost to local SEND and family support. Coordinate with education and social care where appropriate. NICE CKS.

options.label: Assessment
options.guidance:
MANAGEMENT PLAN:
1. Sleep hygiene; sensory factors; routine. Exclude medical causes (OSA, pain). NICE NG76, CKS.

options.label: Management
options.guidance:
MANAGEMENT PLAN:
1. Behavioural strategies; melatonin only if indicated per NICE. Refer sleep clinic if persistent. NICE CKS.

options.label: Learning resource
options.guidance:
MANAGEMENT PLAN:
1. Use as CPD/reflection. Apply NICE CKS and local guidelines to clinical practice. No specific patient pathway.

options.label: Acute idiopathic
options.guidance:
MANAGEMENT PLAN:
1. NSAID (ibuprofen 400 mg tds) + PPI for 1–2 weeks. Colchicine 500 mcg bd can reduce recurrence.
2. Avoid steroids first-line. Rest from strenuous activity.
3. Refer: Large effusion, tamponade, failure to improve. NICE CKS.

options.label: Vasovagal / situational
options.guidance:
MANAGEMENT PLAN:
1. Reassurance; avoid triggers; keep hydrated.
2. Driving: DVLA guidance (group 1: refrain if recurrent).
3. Refer: Cardiac syncope, unexplained recurrent, or red flags (ECG abnormal, HF, exercise-induced). NICE CG109.

options.label: Cardiac / unexplained
options.guidance:
MANAGEMENT PLAN:
1. ECG; consider 24h tape, echo. Refer cardiology if structural or arrhythmia suspected.
2. 2WW if red flags. NICE CG109.

options.label: SVT / narrow complex
options.guidance:
MANAGEMENT PLAN:
1. Acute: Vagal manoeuvres; if haemodynamically stable consider adenosine.
2. Long-term: Refer for ablation or rate control. NICE NG196.

options.label: Broad complex / uncertain
options.guidance:
MANAGEMENT PLAN:
1. ECG; exclude VT. Refer cardiology for monitoring/EP if recurrent or structural heart disease. NICE NG196.

options.label: Raised BNP
options.guidance:
MANAGEMENT PLAN:
1. NT-proBNP >2000: Urgent echo/specialist within 2 weeks. 400–2000: Routine within 6 weeks.
2. Baseline ECG, U&E, FBC, LFT, lipids. NICE NG106.

options.label: ST elevation / acute
options.guidance:
MANAGEMENT PLAN:
1. Emergency 999; aspirin 300 mg. Do not delay for repeat ECG in primary care. NICE NG185.

options.label: BBB / bradycardia / Long QT / Brugada
options.guidance:
MANAGEMENT PLAN:
1. Refer cardiology for pacemaker/ICD assessment if symptomatic or high risk.
2. Avoid QT-prolonging drugs if Long QT. NICE NG203, CKS.

options.label: Severe / symptomatic
options.guidance:
MANAGEMENT PLAN:
1. Refer cardiology/valve clinic. Echo for severity and LV function.
2. Endocarditis prophylaxis: only for high-risk procedures per NICE NG64.

options.label: Mild / surveillance
options.guidance:
MANAGEMENT PLAN:
1. Repeat echo per local protocol (often 1–2 years). Treat HF and AF per guidelines. NICE NG208.

options.label: Medical management
options.guidance:
MANAGEMENT PLAN:
1. Antiplatelet (clopidogrel 75 mg or aspirin). Statin. Treat BP and diabetes. Supervised exercise.
2. Refer vascular if limiting symptoms or critical ischaemia. NICE NG147.

options.label: DAPT duration
options.guidance:
MANAGEMENT PLAN:
1. Post-ACS: DAPT 12 months then single antiplatelet (usually clopidogrel). Consider longer if high ischaemic risk.
2. Post PCI: As per stent type and bleeding risk. NICE NG185.

options.label: Primary prevention
options.guidance:
MANAGEMENT PLAN:
1. QRISK3 ≥10%: Atorvastatin 20 mg; consider 80 mg if high risk. Recheck lipids at 3 months.
2. Target: LDL-C reduction >40%. NICE CG181.

options.label: FH / familial
options.guidance:
MANAGEMENT PLAN:
1. Refer lipid clinic if Simon Broome criteria. Statin from childhood in FH. NICE CG71.

options.label: NICE NG64
options.guidance:
MANAGEMENT PLAN:
1. Antibiotic prophylaxis NOT routinely recommended for dental or GI/GU procedures.
2. Only consider for highest-risk patients (prosthetic valve, previous endocarditis, cyanotic congenital heart disease) having dental at site of infection. NICE NG64.

options.label: Conservative & referral
options.guidance:
MANAGEMENT PLAN:
1. Compression hosiery; leg elevation; weight loss if overweight.
2. Refer if symptomatic, skin changes, or patient choice after conservative trial. NICE CG168.

options.label: Assessment
options.guidance:
MANAGEMENT PLAN:
1. Screening: NHS AAA screening men 65+. Palpation unreliable for detection.
2. If suspected: USS aorta. Risk factors: smoking, hypertension, family history. NICE NG156, CKS.

options.label: Management
options.guidance:
MANAGEMENT PLAN:
1. Small (3–5.4 cm): Annual surveillance USS. Optimise CV risk (statin, BP, smoking cessation).
2. Large (≥5.5 cm or symptomatic): Urgent vascular referral. NICE NG156.

options.label: Referral
options.guidance:
MANAGEMENT PLAN:
1. Urgent: Ruptured or symptomatic (pain, hypotension). 2WW: ≥5.5 cm or rapid expansion. NICE NG156.

options.label: When to refer
options.guidance:
MANAGEMENT PLAN:
1. Indications: Murmur with red flags, suspected HF (BNP raised), syncope, embolic event, suspected valve disease.
2. Urgent: Suspected endocarditis, acute severe regurgitation. NICE NG208, CKS.

options.label: Follow-up
options.guidance:
MANAGEMENT PLAN:
1. Repeat echo per cardiology/serial findings. Treat HF, AF, hypertension per guidelines. NICE NG106, NG208.

options.label: Referral
options.guidance:
MANAGEMENT PLAN:
1. Post-MI, post-CABG/PCI, HF, stable angina: Refer to cardiac rehab (exercise, education, psychological support).
2. Early referral post-discharge. NICE NG106, NG172.

options.label: Management
options.guidance:
MANAGEMENT PLAN:
1. Antiplatelet: Aspirin 75 mg or clopidogrel 75 mg (DAPT duration per cardiology). Statin: atorvastatin 80 mg. Beta-blocker, ACEi/ARNI titrated. Cardiac rehab referral.
2. BP target <140/90; HbA1c if diabetic. Lifestyle: smoking, diet, activity. NICE NG185, NG106, NG172.

options.label: Follow-up
options.guidance:
MANAGEMENT PLAN:
1. Usually led by cardiology/device clinic. Primary care: monitor for infection, ensure anticoagulation/rate control as indicated.
2. Driving: DVLA rules apply (group 1/2). NICE NG106, CKS.

options.label: Small / fluctuant
options.guidance:
MANAGEMENT PLAN:
1. Incision and drainage; send pus if recurrent or cellulitis. Do not use antibiotic alone for uncomplicated abscess.
2. Consider flucloxacillin if cellulitis or systemic symptoms. NICE NG141.

options.label: Recurrent boils
options.guidance:
MANAGEMENT PLAN:
1. Hygiene; nasal decolonisation (mupirocin) if nasal carriage. Screen household. Consider referral if persistent. NICE CKS.

options.label: Mild / moderate
options.guidance:
MANAGEMENT PLAN:
1. Flucloxacillin 500 mg qds 7 days (clarithromycin if penicillin allergic). Elevate limb.
2. Mark margin; review at 48 h. NICE NG141.

options.label: Severe / facial / systemic
options.guidance:
MANAGEMENT PLAN:
1. Admit for IV antibiotics if systemically unwell, facial, or rapid spread. NICE NG141.

options.label: Periorbital / orbital / when to refer
options.guidance:
MANAGEMENT PLAN:
1. Periorbital: Swelling limited to lids; oral antibiotics; same-day review if worsening.
2. Orbital: Proptosis, limited eye movement, vision change – admit urgently (ophthalmology/ENT). Do not confuse with periorbital. NICE NG141.

options.label: Lichen planus
options.guidance:
MANAGEMENT PLAN:
1. Topical potent steroid (e.g. betamethasone) for limited disease. Mouth: topical steroid or specialist.
2. Refer if widespread, genital, or diagnostic uncertainty. NICE CKS.

options.label: Lichen sclerosus
options.guidance:
MANAGEMENT PLAN:
1. Potent topical steroid (e.g. clobetasol) initially; reduce to maintenance. Long-term follow-up (malignancy risk).
2. Refer if diagnostic uncertainty or not responding. NICE CKS.

options.label: Acute
options.guidance:
MANAGEMENT PLAN:
1. Non-sedating antihistamine (cetirizine 10 mg od or loratadine). Avoid trigger if identified.
2. Short course higher dose if severe. NICE CKS.

options.label: Chronic
options.guidance:
MANAGEMENT PLAN:
1. Standard dose non-sedating antihistamine; increase to 4× if needed. Consider add-on (e.g. montelukast, H2 blocker).
2. Refer if not controlled after 6 weeks. NICE CKS.

options.label: Topical
options.guidance:
MANAGEMENT PLAN:
1. Terbinafine 1% or clotrimazole 1% cream for 1–2 weeks. Keep area dry; avoid tight clothing.
2. Oral terbinafine if extensive or failed topical. NICE CKS.

options.label: Cold sore
options.guidance:
MANAGEMENT PLAN:
1. Aciclovir 5% cream 5×/day 5 days, or oral aciclovir 200 mg 5×/day 5 days if early/severe.
2. Suppression: consider if ≥6 episodes/year. NICE CKS.

options.label: First episode genital
options.guidance:
MANAGEMENT PLAN:
1. Aciclovir 400 mg tds 7–10 days (or valaciclovir). Screen for other STIs. Counsel on transmission.
2. Suppression if recurrent. NICE CKS.

options.label: Androgenetic
options.guidance:
MANAGEMENT PLAN:
1. Minoxidil 5% (women 2%) for 6+ months. Finasteride (men only) 1 mg od if minoxidil not sufficient.
2. Reassurance; treat underlying if thyroid/iron. NICE CKS.

options.label: Alopecia areata
options.guidance:
MANAGEMENT PLAN:
1. Potent topical steroid or intralesional steroid. Many resolve spontaneously.
2. Refer if extensive, loss of eyebrows/lashes, or not responding. NICE CKS.

options.label: Generalised (exclude cause)
options.guidance:
MANAGEMENT PLAN:
1. Check FBC, U&E, LFT, TFT, ferritin, glucose. Emollients; sedating antihistamine at night if sleep disturbed.
2. Treat cause if found. Refer if unexplained or refractory. NICE CKS.

options.label: Primary care & referral
options.guidance:
MANAGEMENT PLAN:
1. Compression; skin care; exercise. Exclude venous/renal/cardiac cause.
2. Refer lymphoedema service if significant or secondary to cancer treatment. NICE CKS.

options.label: Suspected / newly diagnosed
options.guidance:
MANAGEMENT PLAN:
1. Emergency: If adrenal crisis – hydrocortisone 100 mg IM stat; IV fluids; admit.
2. Maintenance: Hydrocortisone 15–25 mg daily in 2–3 doses; fludrocortisone if primary. Sick-day rules: double oral hydrocortisone when unwell; injectable emergency hydrocortisone at home.
3. Refer endocrinology for confirmation and education. NICE CKS.

options.label: Screening & referral
options.guidance:
MANAGEMENT PLAN:
1. Suspect in resistant hypertension, hypokalaemia (or normokalaemic). Screen: plasma aldosterone and renin; aldosterone:renin ratio (ARR) raised. Do not adjust antihypertensives that affect renin (e.g. stop spironolactone/eplerenone 4–6 weeks; use alpha-blocker/CCB if needed).
2. Refer endocrinology for confirmatory testing (saline suppression or fludrocortisone suppression) and adrenal imaging. NICE CKS, Local formulary.

options.label: Medical management (post-diagnosis)
options.guidance:
MANAGEMENT PLAN:
1. Mineralocorticoid receptor antagonist: spironolactone or eplerenone per local formulary. Titrate to BP and K+; monitor U&E regularly.
2. Add other antihypertensives as needed. Avoid potassium supplements unless K+ low despite MRA.
3. Surgical option (adrenalectomy) for unilateral adenoma – discuss with endocrinology. NICE CKS, Local formulary.

options.label: Iatrogenic (steroid-induced)
options.guidance:
MANAGEMENT PLAN:
1. Reduce steroid to lowest effective dose; consider topical/inhaled alternatives where possible. Taper slowly to avoid adrenal insufficiency – do not stop abruptly.
2. Monitor: BP, glucose, bone health (DEXA if long-term), weight. Treat hypertension and hyperglycaemia per NICE. Consider bisphosphonate if high fracture risk.
3. Sick-day rules if on any systemic steroid: double dose when unwell; emergency hydrocortisone if unable to take oral. NICE CKS, Local formulary.

options.label: Endogenous / when to suspect
options.guidance:
MANAGEMENT PLAN:
1. Suspect: central obesity, facial plethora, thin skin, bruising, proximal weakness, hypertension, diabetes. Screen: 24 h urinary free cortisol or late-night salivary cortisol; dexamethasone suppression test. Refer endocrinology for confirmation and imaging (pituitary/adrenal).
2. Do not stop exogenous steroids to investigate until under specialist guidance. NICE CKS, Local formulary.

options.label: Sick-day rules
options.guidance:
MANAGEMENT PLAN:
1. Double usual oral glucocorticoid dose during illness (fever, vomiting, diarrhoea, infection, surgery). Do not stop steroid.
2. If unable to take oral: give emergency hydrocortisone IM (e.g. 100 mg) and seek urgent medical care. Ensure patient has emergency hydrocortisone at home and steroid card.
3. Advise when to call 999 or attend A&E. NICE CKS, Local formulary.

options.label: Tapering
options.guidance:
MANAGEMENT PLAN:
1. Taper slowly to allow HPA axis recovery. After >3 weeks therapy, reduce by small increments (e.g. prednisolone 1–2.5 mg every 1–2 weeks); slower if long-term use.
2. Monitor for symptoms of adrenal insufficiency (fatigue, nausea, hypotension). If unwell or surgery needed, increase dose temporarily; sick-day rules apply.
3. Consider short synacthen test if uncertain about axis recovery. NICE CKS, Local formulary.

options.label: Monitoring
options.guidance:
MANAGEMENT PLAN:
1. Lowest effective dose; consider bone protection (calcium, vitamin D; bisphosphonate if high risk). Monitor BP, glucose, weight, lipids.
2. Steroid card and sick-day rules. Ophthalmology if >1 year or high dose (cataract/glaucoma).
3. Consider PCP prophylaxis if prednisolone >20 mg/day and immunosuppressed. NICE CKS, Local formulary.

options.label: Suspicion & referral
options.guidance:
MANAGEMENT PLAN:
1. Suspect: paroxysmal or resistant hypertension, headache, palpitations, sweating. Avoid alpha-blockade before biochemical confirmation.
2. Screen: plasma or urinary metadrenalines; avoid tricyclics, decongestants before test. Refer endocrinology for imaging and surgery planning.
3. If hypertensive crisis: alpha-blocker (e.g. phenoxybenzamine) under specialist guidance. NICE CKS, Local formulary.

options.label: Suspicion & referral
options.guidance:
MANAGEMENT PLAN:
1. Suspect: acral enlargement, coarse features, macroglossia, headache, sweating, arthralgia. IGF-1 (age-adjusted); if raised, refer endocrinology for OGTT with GH and pituitary MRI.
2. Do not delay referral for multiple tests. Comorbidities: diabetes, hypertension, sleep apnoea, cardiac. NICE CKS, Local formulary.

options.label: Medical & referral
options.guidance:
MANAGEMENT PLAN:
1. Exclude drugs (antipsychotics, metoclopramide, etc.), pregnancy, hypothyroidism. MRI pituitary if prolactin significantly raised.
2. Cabergoline first-line for macroprolactinoma or symptomatic microadenoma; titrate to prolactin. Refer endocrinology for diagnosis and follow-up.
3. Monitor visual fields if macroadenoma. NICE CKS, Local formulary.

options.label: Replacement & referral
options.guidance:
MANAGEMENT PLAN:
1. Replace deficient axes: hydrocortisone (sick-day rules), levothyroxine (after cortisol replete), testosterone/oestrogen, GH (specialist). Do not start levothyroxine before glucocorticoid in combined deficiency.
2. Diabetes insipidus: desmopressin if present. Refer endocrinology for confirmation and long-term care. NICE CKS, Local formulary.

options.label: Assessment & management
options.guidance:
MANAGEMENT PLAN:
1. Confirm euvolaemic hyponatraemia: U&E, osmolality, urine Na. Exclude hypothyroidism, cortisol deficiency. Treat cause (drugs, malignancy, lung).
2. Fluid restrict (e.g. 1 L/day); correct slowly to avoid osmotic demyelination. Consider demeclocycline or tolvaptan (specialist) if chronic SIADH.
3. Urgent if severe (Na <125, seizures, coma). NICE CKS, Local formulary.

options.label: Assessment & referral
options.guidance:
MANAGEMENT PLAN:
1. Polyuria, polydipsia, dilute urine. Water deprivation test under specialist guidance; measure urine/osmolarity and serum Na.
2. Cranial: desmopressin. Nephrogenic: treat cause (lithium, drugs); consider thiazide, low-solute diet. Refer endocrinology for confirmation. NICE CKS, Local formulary.

options.label: Mild
options.guidance:
MANAGEMENT PLAN:
1. Corrected calcium; check PTH, vitamin D. Causes: primary hyperparathyroidism, malignancy, vitamin D excess, thiazides. Hydration; avoid calcium/vitamin D supplements.
2. Refer for PTH interpretation and imaging. NICE CKS, Local formulary.

options.label: Severe / emergency
options.guidance:
MANAGEMENT PLAN:
1. Severe (e.g. Ca >3.0): IV fluids, consider bisphosphonate (e.g. IV zoledronate) under specialist guidance. Treat underlying cause.
2. Urgent referral or admission. NICE CKS, Local formulary.

options.label: Assessment & treatment
options.guidance:
MANAGEMENT PLAN:
1. Corrected calcium; PTH, vitamin D, Mg. Causes: hypoparathyroidism, vitamin D deficiency, renal failure, pancreatitis. Acute symptomatic: IV calcium gluconate.
2. Chronic: calcium and vitamin D supplementation; alfacalcidol if hypoparathyroid. Refer endocrinology if persistent or hypoparathyroidism. NICE CKS, Local formulary.

options.label: Raised
options.guidance:
MANAGEMENT PLAN:
1. Corrected calcium; PTH, vitamin D. Causes: primary hyperparathyroidism, malignancy, vitamin D excess. Hydration; avoid calcium/vitamin D supplements. Refer for interpretation. NICE CKS.

options.label: Low
options.guidance:
MANAGEMENT PLAN:
1. Corrected calcium; PTH, vitamin D, Mg. Acute symptomatic: IV calcium gluconate. Chronic: calcium and vitamin D; alfacalcidol if hypoparathyroid. Refer if persistent. NICE CKS.

options.label: Osteoporosis – fracture / DEXA
options.guidance:
MANAGEMENT PLAN:
1. FRAX; DEXA if indicated. Calcium + vitamin D. First-line: oral bisphosphonate (alendronate/risedronate); ensure correct administration. Consider IV zoledronate if oral not tolerated. NICE NG146, CKS.

options.label: Osteoporosis – denosumab / teriparatide
options.guidance:
MANAGEMENT PLAN:
1. Denosumab: 6-monthly SC; do not miss doses (rebound fracture risk). Monitor calcium/vitamin D. Teriparatide: specialist; limited duration. NICE NG146, CKS.

options.label: Osteomalacia / Paget's
options.guidance:
MANAGEMENT PLAN:
1. Osteomalacia: vitamin D repletion; treat cause. Paget's: refer or bisphosphonate per specialist. NICE CKS.

options.label: When to consider
options.guidance:
MANAGEMENT PLAN:
1. After 5 years oral (or 3 years IV) reassess fracture risk. Consider holiday if low–moderate risk; continue if high risk or previous vertebral fracture.
2. Recheck FRAX/DEXA after holiday; restart if risk increases. NICE NG146, CKS.

options.label: Refer & management
options.guidance:
MANAGEMENT PLAN:
1. Refer endocrinology (antithyroid drugs, RAI, or surgery). Do not start antithyroid drugs without specialist if orbitopathy risk. Beta-blocker for symptoms.
2. Monitor TFTs; check TSI/TRab if indicated. NICE NG145, CKS.

options.label: Assessment & referral
options.guidance:
MANAGEMENT PLAN:
1. Painful (subacute): often viral; NSAID; beta-blocker if thyrotoxic. Usually self-limiting. Refer if severe or prolonged.
2. Painless/postpartum: monitor TFTs; treat hypo or hyper as per NICE NG145. NICE CKS.

options.label: Assessment & referral
options.guidance:
MANAGEMENT PLAN:
1. TSH persistently <0.1: assess for atrial fibrillation, osteoporosis; consider referral. TSH 0.1–0.4: repeat in 3–6 months; treat if symptomatic or high risk. NICE NG145, CKS.

options.label: Referral
options.guidance:
MANAGEMENT PLAN:
1. Refer endocrinology for confirmation and treatment (antithyroid drugs, RAI, or surgery). Beta-blocker for symptom relief. Do not start long-term antithyroid without specialist if Graves/orbitopathy.
2. Monitor TFTs. NICE NG145, CKS.

options.label: Diabetic
options.guidance:
MANAGEMENT PLAN:
1. Immediate: 15–20 g fast-acting glucose; recheck in 15 min; repeat if needed. Review medication (sulfonylurea, insulin), diet, driving. Sick-day rules. NICE NG17, NG28.

options.label: Non-diabetic
options.guidance:
MANAGEMENT PLAN:
1. Confirm Whipple’s triad; fasting glucose, insulin, C-peptide, sulfonylurea screen. Consider insulinoma, adrenal insufficiency, drugs. Refer endocrinology. NICE CKS.

options.label: Assessment & management
options.guidance:
MANAGEMENT PLAN:
1. Central obesity plus two of: raised TG, low HDL, raised BP, raised fasting glucose. Address each component: lifestyle (weight, activity), statin, antihypertensive, diabetes prevention. NICE CKS, NG28.

options.label: Suspicion & referral
options.guidance:
MANAGEMENT PLAN:
1. Suspect in fasting hypoglycaemia with Whipple’s triad. 72 h fast (supervised); insulin, C-peptide, glucose; exclude sulfonylurea. Refer endocrinology for imaging and surgery.
2. Do not delay referral. NICE CKS, Local formulary.

options.label: Suspicion & referral
options.guidance:
MANAGEMENT PLAN:
1. Flushing, diarrhoea, wheeze, right heart; 24 h urinary 5-HIAA or chromogranin A. Refer oncology/endocrinology for imaging (NET) and somatostatin analogue. NICE CKS, Local formulary.

options.label: Management & referral
options.guidance:
MANAGEMENT PLAN:
1. Glucocorticoid (and mineralocorticoid if salt-wasting); stress dosing. Monitor growth, electrolytes, 17-OHP/androgens. Refer endocrinology for long-term care.
2. Sick-day rules. NICE CKS, Local formulary.

options.label: Surveillance & referral
options.guidance:
MANAGEMENT PLAN:
1. MEN1: parathyroid, pituitary, pancreas (including insulinoma/gastrinoma). MEN2: MTC, phaeochromocytoma, parathyroid. Refer specialist genetics/endocrinology for screening and surveillance. NICE CKS, Local formulary.

options.label: Assessment & referral
options.guidance:
MANAGEMENT PLAN:
1. Raised PTH with raised or high-normal calcium. Exclude renal failure. Refer endocrinology/surgery for imaging and parathyroidectomy if indicated. Hydration; avoid thiazides. NICE CKS.

options.label: Management
options.guidance:
MANAGEMENT PLAN:
1. Calcium and vitamin D (alfacalcidol/calcitriol); target calcium in low-normal range. Monitor calcium, phosphate, renal function. Refer endocrinology. NICE CKS.

options.label: Referral & surveillance
options.guidance:
MANAGEMENT PLAN:
1. Functioning vs non-functioning; hormone panel; visual fields if macroadenoma. Refer endocrinology/neurosurgery. Replace deficient axes; sick-day rules if cortisol deficient. NICE CKS.

options.label: Assessment & referral
options.guidance:
MANAGEMENT PLAN:
1. Confirm with early-morning testosterone (repeat if borderline); LH/FSH to distinguish primary vs secondary. Exclude reversible causes. Refer urology/endocrinology for replacement if indicated. NICE NG23, CKS.

options.label: Key considerations
options.guidance:
MANAGEMENT PLAN:
1. Lowest effective dose; bone protection (calcium, vitamin D; bisphosphonate if high risk). Monitor BP, glucose, weight. Steroid card and sick-day rules (double dose when unwell; emergency hydrocortisone if unable to take oral).
2. Consider PCP prophylaxis if immunosuppressed. Taper when stopping. NICE CKS, Local formulary.

options.label: Normal TFT
options.guidance:
MANAGEMENT PLAN:
1. TFTs and TPO ab. If diffusely enlarged and euthyroid, observe or refer if compressive symptoms.
2. Nodule: USS + FNA if ≥1 cm or suspicious features. Refer thyroid clinic per local pathway. NICE NG145.

options.label: Abnormal TFT
options.guidance:
MANAGEMENT PLAN:
1. Hypothyroid: Levothyroxine; recheck TSH in 6–8 weeks. Hyperthyroid: Refer endocrinology (antithyroid drugs or RAI). NICE NG145.

options.label: When & how
options.guidance:
MANAGEMENT PLAN:
1. Use to confirm hypertension (clinic BP 140/90+), white-coat effect, or resistant hypertension. Minimum 14 readings daytime, 7 night.
2. Interpret using ABPM thresholds (e.g. daytime ≥135/85). NICE NG136, CKS.

options.label: Post-resuscitation
options.guidance:
MANAGEMENT PLAN:
1. Echo, coronary assessment; treat reversible cause. ICD if LVEF ≤35% or high-risk arrhythmia. Cardiac rehab.
2. Driving: Group 1 disqualified until specialist clearance; Group 2 6–12 months. NICE NG185, DVLA.

options.label: Assessment & referral
options.guidance:
MANAGEMENT PLAN:
1. If symptomatic or frequent: ECG, echo; exclude structural heart disease and channelopathy. Reduce stimulants; treat anxiety if relevant.
2. Refer if structural disease, sustained VT, or very frequent. Beta-blocker or calcium channel blocker for symptoms. NICE CKS.

options.label: Expected death
options.guidance:
MANAGEMENT PLAN:
1. Confirm absence of pulse, breathing, response; record time. If expected and you attended in last 28 days (14 in Scotland), complete MCCD. Advise family on next steps (funeral director, registering death).
2. Follow local policy and RCGP guidance. NICE CKS, Local formulary.

options.label: Unexpected / referral to coroner
options.guidance:
MANAGEMENT PLAN:
1. Do not complete MCCD if cause unknown, suspicious, or referral required. Contact coroner (England/Wales) or procurator fiscal (Scotland) per local protocol.
2. Support family; document clearly. NICE CKS, Local formulary.

options.label: Discussion & form
options.guidance:
MANAGEMENT PLAN:
1. Document preferences for CPR, treatment escalation, preferred place of death. Use ReSPECT or local DNAR form; copy to OOH/ambulance.
2. Review with patient and family; update if wishes change. NICE NG108, Local formulary.

options.label: Issuing
options.guidance:
MANAGEMENT PLAN:
1. Duration appropriate to condition; phased return if helpful. Consider 'may be fit for work' with modifications. No need to state diagnosis.
2. Safety-net and review. NICE NG12, gov.uk fit note guidance.

options.label: Indication & technique
options.guidance:
MANAGEMENT PLAN:
1. Consent; chaperone; explain. Position (left lateral). Inspect; lubricant; assess tone, mass, tenderness, prostate (size, consistency, nodules) if male.
2. Indications: rectal bleeding, change in bowel habit, suspected prostate pathology, constipation/impaction. 2WW if palpable mass or high suspicion. NICE NG12, CKS.

options.label: Assessment
options.guidance:
MANAGEMENT PLAN:
1. Assess capacity per MCA: understand, retain, weigh, communicate. Decision-specific. Best interests if lacking capacity; involve family/IMCA.
2. DoLS/LPS if deprivation of liberty in care. NICE NG108, CKS.

options.label: Routine & follow-up
options.guidance:
MANAGEMENT PLAN:
1. Invite per NHS programme (25–64). If abnormal: refer colposcopy per pathway (HPV triage).
2. Manage anxiety; ensure result and follow-up communicated. NICE NG12, NHS CSP.

options.label: Insertion & care
options.guidance:
MANAGEMENT PLAN:
1. Aseptic technique; correct size (e.g. 12–14Ch). Trial without catheter when appropriate. Document indication and review date.
2. Long-term: change per protocol; screen for infection only if symptomatic. NICE NG12, CKS.

options.label: Technique
options.guidance:
MANAGEMENT PLAN:
1. Consent; correct bottles and order. Avoid prolonged tourniquet. Label at bedside; send promptly.
2. Follow local phlebotomy policy. NICE CKS, Local formulary.

options.label: Insertion & care
options.guidance:
MANAGEMENT PLAN:
1. Aseptic technique; smallest gauge for indication. Secure; document site and date. Remove when no longer needed.
2. Monitor for phlebitis/infection. NICE CKS, Local formulary.

options.label: When & how
options.guidance:
MANAGEMENT PLAN:
1. Before antibiotics if sepsis/bacteraemia suspected. Clean skin; multiple sets from different sites if indicated. Document indication.
2. Do not delay empiric antibiotics for culture. NICE NG51, CKS.

options.label: Support
options.guidance:
MANAGEMENT PLAN:
1. Listen; address concerns with evidence. Offer reliable resources (NHS, PHE). No coercion.
2. Document; offer catch-up. NICE CKS, PHE Green Book.

options.label: Antiviral
options.guidance:
MANAGEMENT PLAN:
1. Nirmatrelvir/ritonavir or remdesivir for highest-risk if within 5 days. Follow local protocol. NICE NG159, CKS.

options.label: Choice by area
options.guidance:
MANAGEMENT PLAN:
1. Risk area: atovaquone-proguanil, doxycycline, or mefloquine per destination. Start before travel; continue after return per drug. Avoid in pregnancy (consider deferral). NICE CKS, NaTHNaC.

options.label: Treatment
options.guidance:
MANAGEMENT PLAN:
1. Urgent; species and severity determine regimen. Admit if severe. Follow UK malaria treatment guidelines. NICE CKS.

options.label: Testing & referral
options.guidance:
MANAGEMENT PLAN:
1. Offer test in high-prevalence areas/settings. If positive: refer HIV service; do not delay. Support re stigma. NICE NG33, CKS.

options.label: Management
options.guidance:
MANAGEMENT PLAN:
1. Refer GUM for confirmation and treatment. Contact tracing. Penicillin first-line. NICE NG33, CKS.

options.label: Overview
options.guidance:
MANAGEMENT PLAN:
1. CTO allows supervised community treatment after detention. Conditions may include medication, residence. Recall to hospital if breach. NICE NG10, MHA.

options.label: Section 2 / 3
options.guidance:
MANAGEMENT PLAN:
1. Section 2: assessment (up to 28 days). Section 3: treatment (up to 6 months, renewable). Two doctors + AMHP; nearest relative considerations.
2. After detention: inform patient of rights, copy to care team. NICE NG10, MHA 1983 (as amended).

options.label: Care & prescribing
options.guidance:
MANAGEMENT PLAN:
1. Recognise dying (GSF, NICE); communicate with family. Anticipatory drugs: analgesia, anti-secretory, antiemetic, anxiolytic. Review and stop non-essential meds.
2. Support family; verify death when appropriate. NICE NG142, GSF.

options.label: Group 1 (car/motorcycle)
options.guidance:
MANAGEMENT PLAN:
1. Advise per DVLA guidance: notify DVLA if condition affects safety (e.g. epilepsy, syncope, insulin-treated diabetes). Temporary surrender or licence review.
2. Document advice given. Gov.uk DVLA, NICE CKS.

options.label: Group 2 / flying
options.guidance:
MANAGEMENT PLAN:
1. Group 2 (HGV/PSV): stricter standards; report to DVLA. Flying: advise per condition (DVT risk, oxygen, cabin pressure). NICE CKS, CAA.

options.label: DoLS / LPS
options.guidance:
MANAGEMENT PLAN:
1. When person lacks capacity and is under continuous supervision in care/hospital. Apply to supervisory body (local authority).
2. LPS (England) replacing DoLS; advance planning. NICE NG108, MCA.

options.label: Completion
options.guidance:
MANAGEMENT PLAN:
1. Two-part form (Form 4/5): confirm no concern about cause of death; second doctor independent. Fee applicable.
2. Follow Cremation Regulations. Local formulary.

options.label: Catch-up & travel
options.guidance:
MANAGEMENT PLAN:
1. Green Book; catch-up for incomplete childhood. Influenza, COVID, pneumococcal, shingles per eligibility. Travel: advise on destination vaccines.
2. Document consent and batch. NICE CKS, PHE/UKHSA.

options.label: Interpretation
options.guidance:
MANAGEMENT PLAN:
1. Pre- and post-bronchodilator; quality checks. Obstruction: FEV1/FVC <0.7. Restriction: reduced FVC, proportionately. Refer if diagnostic uncertainty or severe.
2. NICE NG115, NG80, BTS.

options.label: Technique
options.guidance:
MANAGEMENT PLAN:
1. Clean wound; consider closure if <24 h and low risk. Sutures vs glue vs steri-strips by site and tension. Tetanus if indicated.
2. Remove sutures by site (face 3–5 d, limb 7–10 d). NICE CKS.

options.label: Indication & sampling
options.guidance:
MANAGEMENT PLAN:
1. Diagnostic or therapeutic. Send for cell count, protein, culture, cytology if indicated. Albumin if considering SBP.
2. Consider coagulation; ultrasound guidance. NICE CKS, Local formulary.

options.label: Sampling
options.guidance:
MANAGEMENT PLAN:
1. Send fluid for protein, LDH, pH, cytology, culture. Light's criteria for exudate vs transudate. Consider image guidance.
2. Therapeutic tap if symptomatic; avoid removing >1.5 L. NICE CKS.

options.label: Indication & referral
options.guidance:
MANAGEMENT PLAN:
1. Exclude raised ICP (imaging if concern). Send CSF for cells, protein, glucose, culture, viral PCR. Consider specialist perform.
2. Post-LP: lie flat; monitor headache. NICE NG51, CKS.

options.label: Biopsy / cryotherapy
options.guidance:
MANAGEMENT PLAN:
1. Punch biopsy: consent; suture or cautery. Send in formalin with form. Cryotherapy: liquid nitrogen for warts/keratosis; advise blistering.
2. Follow local dermatology policy. NICE CKS.

options.label: Joint / IM
options.guidance:
MANAGEMENT PLAN:
1. Aseptic technique; correct site (e.g. Z-track IM). Joint: confirm no sepsis; steroid ± local anaesthetic per indication.
2. Document site, drug, batch. NICE CKS, Local formulary.

options.label: Prescribing
options.guidance:
MANAGEMENT PLAN:
1. Lowest dose, shortest duration. Bone protection if >3 months. Steroid card; sick-day rules. Taper when stopping.
2. NICE CKS, Local formulary.

options.label: Guidance
options.guidance:
MANAGEMENT PLAN:
1. CQC: register regulated activities per guidance. Fast track CHC: complete DS1500 for rapidly deteriorating; support application.
2. Follow NHS CHC framework. NICE CKS, gov.uk.

options.label: Topical
options.guidance:
MANAGEMENT PLAN:
1. Salicylic acid (e.g. 12–26%) daily; paring if thick. Consider cryotherapy for common warts. Genital warts: refer or treat per CKS.
2. Reassure; many resolve. Refer if recalcitrant or diagnostic uncertainty. NICE CKS.

options.label: Treatment
options.guidance:
MANAGEMENT PLAN:
1. Folliculitis: topical fusidic acid or oral flucloxacillin if extensive. Fungal groin: topical terbinafine or clotrimazole; keep dry.
2. Intertrigo: barrier cream; topical antifungal if Candida. NICE CKS.

options.label: Vitiligo / granuloma annulare
options.guidance:
MANAGEMENT PLAN:
1. Vitiligo: sun protection; topical steroid or calcineurin inhibitor for active patches. Refer if extensive or cosmetic concern. Granuloma annulare: often self-limiting; topical steroid if localised.
2. BCC/SCC in situ: refer per 2WW or local pathway. NICE CKS, NG12.

options.label: Treatment
options.guidance:
MANAGEMENT PLAN:
1. Head lice: wet combing or dimeticone/lotion (check resistance). Two applications 7 days apart. Pubic lice: permethrin or malathion; treat contacts.
2. NICE CKS.

options.label: Treatment
options.guidance:
MANAGEMENT PLAN:
1. Confirm (culture/PCR). Terbinafine oral 6–12 weeks (fingernail shorter). Topical amorolfine if limited. Check LFT if oral.
2. Refer if diagnostic uncertainty or treatment failure. NICE CKS.

options.label: Assessment
options.guidance:
MANAGEMENT PLAN:
1. Erythema multiforme: often viral; supportive. Erythema nodosum: treat cause; NSAID. Stop culprit drug. SJS/TEN: emergency – admit; stop drug; supportive care.
2. Drug eruption: stop drug; antihistamine/moderate steroid if needed. NICE CKS.

options.label: Referral
options.guidance:
MANAGEMENT PLAN:
1. Pyoderma gangrenosum: wound care; often need systemic treatment – refer dermatology. Dermatitis herpetiformis: gluten-free; dapsone if needed – refer. Dermatomyositis/Lupus/Scleroderma: refer rheumatology/dermatology.
2. Hirsutism: treat underlying (PCOS); cosmetic options. NICE CKS.

options.label: Topical treatment
options.guidance:
MANAGEMENT PLAN:
1. Topical acetic acid 2% or topical antibiotic (e.g. gentamicin/hydrocortisone or neomycin) for 7 days. Avoid water in ear.
2. Consider ear wick if canal swollen. Oral flucloxacillin if cellulitis. NICE CKS.

options.label: Referral
options.guidance:
MANAGEMENT PLAN:
1. Suspect if dysphagia, regurgitation. Barium swallow or manometry. Refer gastroenterology for pneumatic dilation or surgery.
2. NICE CKS.

options.label: Acute
options.guidance:
MANAGEMENT PLAN:
1. Hydration; avoid antimotility if infective. Stool culture if bloody, systemic, or recent antibiotic (C. difficile). Antibiotic only if indicated (e.g. C. difficile, traveller's).
2. NICE NG84, CKS.

options.label: Chronic
options.guidance:
MANAGEMENT PLAN:
1. Coeliac serology, FBC, CRP, TTG; consider FIT, calprotectin. Refer if red flags or persistent. NICE CKS.

options.label: When to refer / red flags
options.guidance:
MANAGEMENT PLAN:
1. Admit: Severe dehydration, sepsis, bloody diarrhoea with systemic illness. 2WW: Unexplained chronic, weight loss, anaemia. Stool culture if C. difficile risk. NICE NG84, NG12.

options.label: Fissure / haemorrhoids
options.guidance:
MANAGEMENT PLAN:
1. Fissure: fibre, GTN or diltiazem ointment. Haemorrhoids: fibre, topical preparation; thrombosed: analgesia, consider referral. Fistula/pilonidal: refer.
2. NICE CKS.

options.label: Ascites / cirrhosis
options.guidance:
MANAGEMENT PLAN:
1. Ascites: salt restrict, diuretic (spironolactone ± furosemide). SBP prophylaxis if indicated. Refer hepatology. Hepatic encephalopathy: treat precipitant; lactulose.
2. NICE CKS.

options.label: Gallstones
options.guidance:
MANAGEMENT PLAN:
1. Biliary colic: analgesia. Cholecystitis: admit. Asymptomatic stones: discuss cholecystectomy if diabetic or high risk. NICE NG104, CKS.

options.label: Management
options.guidance:
MANAGEMENT PLAN:
1. Cirrhosis with varices: non-selective beta-blocker (e.g. propranolol) or band ligation. Refer hepatology. Primary prophylaxis to reduce first bleed.
2. Acute bleed: emergency; resuscitate; terlipressin/octreotide; refer. NICE NG50, CKS.

options.label: Barrett's / gastritis
options.guidance:
MANAGEMENT PLAN:
1. Barrett's: surveillance endoscopy per local protocol. H. pylori: test and treat. Gastritis: PPI; consider endoscopy if atrophic or concern.
2. 2WW: dysphagia, weight loss, bleeding, anaemia – NICE NG12.

options.label: Acute
options.guidance:
MANAGEMENT PLAN:
1. Admit if acute. NBM, IV fluids, analgesia. Gallstones: cholecystectomy after recovery. NICE NG104.

options.label: Chronic
options.guidance:
MANAGEMENT PLAN:
1. Pain relief; pancreatic enzyme replacement; diabetes screening. Refer gastroenterology. NICE CKS.

options.label: Assessment & referral
options.guidance:
MANAGEMENT PLAN:
1. RIF pain, nausea, fever. Do not delay referral if suspected. Paediatric: use age-appropriate scoring.
2. Urgent surgical referral. NICE CKS.

options.label: Assessment & referral
options.guidance:
MANAGEMENT PLAN:
1. RUQ pain, fever, Murphy's positive. USS; FBC, LFT, CRP. Admit for IV antibiotics and surgical review. NICE NG104.

options.label: Hepatitis C
options.guidance:
MANAGEMENT PLAN:
1. Test: anti-HCV; if positive, HCV RNA. Refer for DAA treatment. NICE NG115.

options.label: NAFLD
options.guidance:
MANAGEMENT PLAN:
1. Lifestyle; rule out other liver disease. Fibrosis (FIB-4/ELF); refer if advanced. NICE NG49.

options.label: IBD / colitis
options.guidance:
MANAGEMENT PLAN:
1. IBD: refer; maintain on treatment per specialist. Microscopic colitis: consider budesonide. Rectal bleeding: FIT, sigmoidoscopy/colonoscopy per pathway.
2. NICE NG129, NG12.

options.label: Liver / rare
options.guidance:
MANAGEMENT PLAN:
1. Autoimmune hepatitis/PBC/PSC: refer hepatology. Haemochromatosis: venesection. Wilson's: refer. Gastroparesis: diet, prokinetic; refer. NICE CKS.

options.label: When to request
options.guidance:
MANAGEMENT PLAN:
1. Unexplained cough >3 weeks, haemoptysis, suspected cancer, pneumonia, pleural effusion, suspected TB, or red flags. NICE NG12, NG120.

options.label: Assessment & referral
options.guidance:
MANAGEMENT PLAN:
1. LTOT: Assess when stable on optimal treatment; pO2 <7.3 kPa (or <8 with complications). Refer respiratory for assessment. NICE NG115.

options.label: 2WW referral
options.guidance:
MANAGEMENT PLAN:
1. Haemoptysis; CXR suggestive; persistent cough with red flags. Refer via 2WW. NICE NG12.

options.label: Pleural effusion
options.guidance:
MANAGEMENT PLAN:
1. CXR; consider tap for diagnosis. Light's criteria. Refer if exudate, malignant, or symptomatic. NICE CKS.

options.label: Haemoptysis / cancer
options.guidance:
MANAGEMENT PLAN:
1. Haemoptysis: 2WW lung cancer. Cough: no antibiotic for acute bronchitis; consider asthma/ACE-i. Pulmonary nodule: refer per NICE. NICE NG12, NG120.

options.label: Emergency
options.guidance:
MANAGEMENT PLAN:
1. Acute scrotal pain – treat as torsion until proven otherwise. Urgent surgical referral (same-day). Do not delay for imaging. NICE CKS.

options.label: When to refer
options.guidance:
MANAGEMENT PLAN:
1. Refer if cause unclear, stage 3 AKI, no improvement, or complications. Stop nephrotoxics; correct volume/electrolytes. NICE NG148, NG203.

options.label: Management & referral
options.guidance:
MANAGEMENT PLAN:
1. Usually presents with nephrotic syndrome (oedema, hypoalbuminaemia, proteinuria). Confirm diagnosis (renal biopsy); exclude secondary causes (malignancy, HBV/HCV, SLE, drugs).
2. Refer nephrology: immunosuppression (e.g. rituximab, cyclophosphamide/steroid) per KDIGO/NICE. ACEi/ARB for proteinuria; treat hypertension; thromboprophylaxis if nephrotic. NICE NG203, CKS.

options.label: Management & referral
options.guidance:
MANAGEMENT PLAN:
1. Confirm diagnosis (biopsy). Supportive: ACEi/ARB to target BP and proteinuria; avoid nephrotoxics. Treat infections (can trigger flares).
2. Refer nephrology: immunosuppression if progressive (e.g. eGFR decline, persistent proteinuria). NICE NG203, CKS.

options.label: Management & referral
options.guidance:
MANAGEMENT PLAN:
1. Oedema, hypoalbuminaemia, heavy proteinuria. Child: refer paediatric nephrology; often steroid-sensitive. Adult: refer nephrology; exclude cause (diabetes, amyloid, glomerulonephritis).
2. Supportive: fluid/salt restriction; diuretics; thromboprophylaxis if severe. Treat infection. NICE NG203, CKS.

options.label: Management & referral
options.guidance:
MANAGEMENT PLAN:
1. Haematuria, proteinuria, hypertension, renal impairment. Urgent nephrology referral for RPGN, nephrotic, or rapidly rising creatinine. Urinalysis, U&E, eGFR, albumin, complement, ANA/dsDNA if SLE suspected.
2. Supportive: BP control (ACEi/ARB if no contraindication); avoid nephrotoxics. Biopsy usually required. NICE NG203, CKS.

options.label: Management & referral
options.guidance:
MANAGEMENT PLAN:
1. Renal involvement in SLE: proteinuria, haematuria, impaired eGFR. Urgent nephrology/rheumatology referral. Biopsy for classification (ISN/RPS).
2. Immunosuppression (e.g. mycophenolate, cyclophosphamide, steroids) per rheumatology/nephrology. ACEi/ARB; BP target. NICE NG203, CKS.

options.label: Management & referral
options.guidance:
MANAGEMENT PLAN:
1. ADPKD: USS diagnosis; family screening. Monitor BP, eGFR, albuminuria. Tolvaptan may be offered (nephrology) in selected adults with rapid progression.
2. Refer nephrology: declining eGFR, hypertension difficult to control, or family screening. Screen for liver cysts, intracranial aneurysm in selected cases. NICE NG203, CKS.

options.label: Management & referral
options.guidance:
MANAGEMENT PLAN:
1. Treat cause; stop nephrotoxics; correct volume/electrolytes. Monitor U&E, eGFR, urine output.
2. Refer if cause unclear, stage 3 AKI, no improvement, or complications. NICE NG148, NG203.

options.label: Management & referral
options.guidance:
MANAGEMENT PLAN:
1. Pain: NSAIDs first-line (any route); paracetamol if contraindicated; opioids only if both insufficient. Do not offer antispasmodics.
2. Imaging: Low-dose non-contrast CT within 24h (adults); USS in pregnancy/children; consider CT if diagnosis uncertain in children.
3. Alpha-blocker may be considered for distal ureteric stone <10mm (medical expulsive therapy).
4. Urgent/emergency referral: sepsis, obstructed infected kidney, uncontrolled pain, AKI/anuria, diagnostic uncertainty (e.g. AAA, peritonitis). Routine follow-up in primary care if pain controlled. NICE NG118, CKS Renal colic.

options.label: Management & referral
options.guidance:
MANAGEMENT PLAN:
1. Overactive bladder: anticholinergic (e.g. oxybutynin, tolterodine) or beta-3 agonist (mirabegron). Stress incontinence: pelvic floor exercises; consider duloxetine or surgery if failed.
2. Exclude UTI, retention, red flags. 2WW: haematuria. Refer urology if refractory or mixed. NICE NG123, CKS.

options.label: Management & referral
options.guidance:
MANAGEMENT PLAN:
1. Exclude vascular, diabetes, psychological. PDE5i first-line (sildenafil, tadalafil); advise on use. Check testosterone if low libido.
2. Refer if failure of oral treatment, penile deformity, or young with vascular concern. NICE NG23, CKS.

options.label: Management & referral
options.guidance:
MANAGEMENT PLAN:
1. Antibiotics: ofloxacin or ceftriaxone if STI likely; co-amoxiclav if UTI/enteric. Exclude torsion (urgent surgical referral if suspected).
2. 2WW: testicular mass. Support, scrotal elevation, analgesia. NICE NG12, CKS.

options.label: Management & referral
options.guidance:
MANAGEMENT PLAN:
1. Acute bacterial prostatitis: antibiotic (e.g. ciprofloxacin); admit if septic. Chronic: trial antibiotic; consider alpha-blocker. Urethritis: STI screen; treat for chlamydia/gonorrhoea per local policy.
2. Refer if recurrent, chronic pelvic pain, or diagnostic uncertainty. NICE CKS.

options.label: Management & referral
options.guidance:
MANAGEMENT PLAN:
1. Acute retention: catheterise; treat cause (constipation, drugs, infection). Urethral stricture: refer urology; may need dilatation or urethroplasty.
2. Do not leave in retention; rule out cord compression if acute with neurology. NICE CKS.

options.label: Management & referral
options.guidance:
MANAGEMENT PLAN:
1. Exclude torsion (urgent surgical referral). USS if mass or uncertainty. Hydrocele: refer if symptomatic or diagnostic uncertainty. Varicocele: refer if symptomatic or size concern.
2. 2WW: testicular mass. NICE NG12, CKS.

options.label: Management & referral
options.guidance:
MANAGEMENT PLAN:
1. Fournier's gangrene: emergency referral; IV antibiotics; resuscitation. Paraphimosis: manual reduction or emergency referral. Priapism: emergency urology; aspirate/irrigate if prolonged.
2. Do not delay. NICE CKS.

options.label: Management & referral
options.guidance:
MANAGEMENT PLAN:
1. Reassurance; often stabilises. No proven medical therapy. Refer urology if deformity affects intercourse, pain, or for surgical opinion.
2. Exclude malignancy in penile lesion. NICE CKS.

options.label: Management & referral
options.guidance:
MANAGEMENT PLAN:
1. Pelvic floor exercises first-line. Pessary if preferred or awaiting surgery. Avoid heavy lifting; treat constipation.
2. Refer gynaecology if symptomatic, prolapse beyond introitus, or for surgery. NICE NG23, CKS.

options.label: Management & referral
options.guidance:
MANAGEMENT PLAN:
1. Visible haematuria (any age): 2WW urology. Non-visible: exclude UTI; if persistent and ≥45y or other risk factors, refer 2WW. Dipstick in pregnancy: exclude UTI/pre-eclampsia.
2. NICE NG12, CKS.

options.label: Management & referral
options.guidance:
MANAGEMENT PLAN:
1. 2WW for testicular mass or unexplained testicular symptoms. Examine; USS if uncertainty. Do not delay for imaging if high suspicion.
2. NICE NG12, CKS.

options.label: Management & referral
options.guidance:
MANAGEMENT PLAN:
1. Do not treat except in pregnancy (prevents pyelonephritis) or before urological surgery. Treat in pregnancy with antibiotic per sensitivities.
2. No treatment in diabetic women, elderly, or catheterised unless symptomatic. NICE NG109, CKS.

options.label: Management & referral
options.guidance:
MANAGEMENT PLAN:
1. Paediatric renal tumour: abdominal mass, haematuria, hypertension. Urgent paediatric oncology referral. Do not biopsy in primary care.
2. NICE NG12, CKS.

options.label: Management & referral
options.guidance:
MANAGEMENT PLAN:
1. BP control; avoid ACEi/ARB if bilateral or single kidney until specialist review. Cardiovascular risk reduction. Duplex/USS for diagnosis.
2. Refer nephrology/vascular: refractory hypertension, declining eGFR, flash pulmonary oedema. Revascularisation in selected cases. NICE NG203, CKS.

options.label: Management & referral
options.guidance:
MANAGEMENT PLAN:
1. 2WW: Visible haematuria, loin mass, unexplained flank pain. CT abdomen for characterisation. Do not delay if high suspicion.
2. NICE NG12, CKS.

options.label: Management & referral
options.guidance:
MANAGEMENT PLAN:
1. ANCA-associated vasculitis: urgent nephrology/rheumatology. Biopsy for diagnosis. Immunosuppression (e.g. rituximab, cyclophosphamide + steroids).
2. Supportive: BP control; avoid nephrotoxics. NICE NG203, CKS.

options.label: Management & referral
options.guidance:
MANAGEMENT PLAN:
1. Pelvic floor exercises; pessary if preferred. Avoid heavy lifting; treat constipation.
2. Refer gynaecology if symptomatic or for surgery. NICE NG23, CKS.

options.label: AKI / glomerular
options.guidance:
MANAGEMENT PLAN:
1. AKI: treat cause; stop nephrotoxics; fluid/electrolytes. Nephrotic/glomerulonephritis: refer nephrology. NICE NG148, NG203.

options.label: LUTS / erectile / scrotal
options.guidance:
MANAGEMENT PLAN:
1. Overactive bladder: anticholinergic or beta-3 agonist. ED: exclude vascular/psychological; PDE5i. Epididymitis: antibiotics. 2WW: haematuria, testicular mass. NICE NG12, CKS.

options.label: Management
options.guidance:
MANAGEMENT PLAN:
1. Exclude lump (examine; refer if lump). Cyclical: reassurance, supportive bra; consider evening primrose oil. Non-cyclical: exclude musculoskeletal. NICE CKS.

options.label: Contraception / bleeding
options.guidance:
MANAGEMENT PLAN:
1. HMB: Levonorgestrel IUS, tranexamic acid. IMB/PCB: speculum; swabs; 2WW if PMB. Contraception: choice per need; POP/COCP/implant/IUD per CKS.
2. NICE NG88, NG3, CKS.

options.label: Infection / pain / 2WW
options.guidance:
MANAGEMENT PLAN:
1. Vaginal infection: Candida/BV/Trichomonas – treat per CKS. Pelvic pain: exclude PID; consider endometriosis. 2WW: breast lump, PMB, cervical/ovarian/endometrial concern. NICE NG12, NG3.

options.label: Vaginal discharge – when to refer
options.guidance:
MANAGEMENT PLAN:
1. Candida: topical clotrimazole or oral fluconazole. BV: metronidazole. Trichomonas: metronidazole; treat contacts. 2WW: postmenopausal bleeding, cervical concern. Refer if recurrent, pregnant, or diagnostic uncertainty. NICE CKS, NG12.

options.label: Anxiety / GAD / panic
options.guidance:
MANAGEMENT PLAN:
1. CBT first-line; SSRI if preferred or moderate–severe. Benzodiazepines short-term only. Reduce gradually. NICE NG226, CKS.

options.label: Bipolar / psychosis / monitoring
options.guidance:
MANAGEMENT PLAN:
1. Lithium: check U&E, TFT, Ca; therapeutic level. Clozapine: FBC monitoring. Section 2/3: MHA process; inform rights. NICE NG222, NG10.

options.label: Eating / other
options.guidance:
MANAGEMENT PLAN:
1. Eating disorders: refer if suspected. Gambling/hoarding: signpost; consider referral. Delirium: treat cause; avoid antipsychotic unless distress. NICE NG69, CKS.

options.label: Crisis / when to section
options.guidance:
MANAGEMENT PLAN:
1. Risk: Assess suicide/self-harm and risk to others. Crisis team/section: MHA assessment if detention needed (Section 2/3). Inform patient of rights; nearest relative. 2. De-escalation; avoid coercion unless risk. NICE NG10, NG222, CKS.

options.label: Soft tissue / tendon
options.guidance:
MANAGEMENT PLAN:
1. Rest, ice, analgesia; physio. Plantar fasciitis: stretch, orthotics. Tennis elbow: eccentric exercises. Rotator cuff: physio; consider injection. NICE CKS, NG124.

options.label: Joint / arthritis / red flags
options.guidance:
MANAGEMENT PLAN:
1. GCA: urgent high-dose steroid; refer. Polymyalgia: steroid; monitor. Pseudogout: NSAID. Septic arthritis: emergency referral. NICE NG210, NG100.

options.label: Management
options.guidance:
MANAGEMENT PLAN:
1. Reassurance; antipyretics for comfort. Exclude meningitis (red flags). Most simple febrile seizures don't need EEG or imaging.
2. Refer if complex, prolonged, or parental concern. NICE NG143, CKS.

options.label: Assessment
options.guidance:
MANAGEMENT PLAN:
1. History: timing, IgE vs non-IgE. Consider SPT/sIgE if IgE-mediated. Trial exclusion for non-IgE.
2. Refer if anaphylaxis, multiple foods, or diagnostic uncertainty. NICE CG116.

options.label: Management
options.guidance:
MANAGEMENT PLAN:
1. Supportive. Fever then rash (HHV-6). Exclude other causes if unwell. NICE CKS.

options.label: Safeguarding
options.guidance:
MANAGEMENT PLAN:
1. Follow safeguarding policy; do not investigate alone. Refer to social care/police as per local protocol. Document. NICE NG76.

options.label: Assessment
options.guidance:
MANAGEMENT PLAN:
1. Growth, hips (Ortolani/Barlow), heart (murmur), eyes (red reflex), testes. Maternal mental health. NICE NG11, CKS.

options.label: Referral
options.guidance:
MANAGEMENT PLAN:
1. Refer by 6 months (corrected for prematurity) for surgical opinion. Do not confuse with retractile. NICE NG11, CKS.

options.label: Follow-up
options.guidance:
MANAGEMENT PLAN:
1. Usually shared care with cardiology. Monitor growth, saturations, medication. Endocarditis prophylaxis per NICE NG64. NICE CKS.

options.label: Management & referral
options.guidance:
MANAGEMENT PLAN:
1. Circumcision: Not routinely recommended for physiological phimosis (resolves with time). If pathological phimosis or parental request after discussion: refer to paediatric surgery/urology.
2. Phimosis: Topical steroid (e.g. betamethasone 0.05% once daily for 4–8 weeks) if ballooning or infection; refer if failed or scarring. NICE CKS.
3. Hypospadias: Refer to paediatric urology (surgical correction). Do not circumcise before referral. NICE NG11, NG111, CKS.

options.label: Management & referral
options.guidance:
MANAGEMENT PLAN:
1. Most cases self-limiting: supportive care, rest until symptoms resolve. Analgesia (paracetamol/ibuprofen) for joint/abdominal pain.
2. Monitor: BP, urinalysis (blood/protein), serum creatinine and electrolytes. Repeat urine at 1–2 weeks and after resolution (risk of nephritis).
3. Refer: Nephritis, severe abdominal pain, GI bleed, orchitis, or organ-threatening disease. Urgent if unwell or renal impairment. NICE CKS.

options.label: Management & referral
options.guidance:
MANAGEMENT PLAN:
1. Reassurance: self-limiting; resolves when growth plate fuses. Rest from aggravating activity; ice after sport; simple analgesia.
2. Physiotherapy: quadriceps stretching and strengthening. Consider patellar strap.
3. Refer if diagnostic uncertainty, severe pain, or bilateral with systemic features. NICE CKS.

options.label: Management & referral
options.guidance:
MANAGEMENT PLAN:
1. Suspected Perthes (limp, hip/knee pain, 4–8 years): Urgent orthopaedic referral. X-ray and/or MRI.
2. Avoid weight-bearing if confirmed; physiotherapy; containment if indicated. NICE CKS.

options.label: Management & referral
options.guidance:
MANAGEMENT PLAN:
1. Suspect in obese adolescent with hip/knee pain or limp. Emergency orthopaedic referral; non-weight-bearing until assessed.
2. Surgical pinning to prevent further slip. NICE CKS.

options.label: Management & referral
options.guidance:
MANAGEMENT PLAN:
1. Assess curve (Adam's forward bend); if suspected, refer orthopaedics/spinal. Monitor if mild and growing.
2. Red flags: rapid progression, pain, neurology, infantile/juvenile. NICE CKS.

options.label: Management & referral
options.guidance:
MANAGEMENT PLAN:
1. Septic arthritis/osteomyelitis: emergency referral. Do not delay for imaging. Bloods (FBC, CRP), blood culture if febrile.
2. Transient synovitis: supportive; review if not improving. NICE NG143, CKS.

options.label: Management & referral
options.guidance:
MANAGEMENT PLAN:
1. Supportive: paracetamol (avoid ibuprofen); calamine; keep cool. Isolate until lesions crusted.
2. Refer: Immunocompromised, neonatal, pregnant contact, complications (encephalitis, pneumonia, bacterial sepsis). Aciclovir if high risk. NICE CKS.

options.label: Management & referral
options.guidance:
MANAGEMENT PLAN:
1. Suspect: fever ≥5 days + rash, conjunctivitis, cracked lips, lymph nodes, palm/sole changes. Urgent paediatric referral.
2. IVIG + aspirin to reduce coronary aneurysm risk. Echocardiography. NICE CKS.

options.label: Management & referral
options.guidance:
MANAGEMENT PLAN:
1. Reassurance: most simple febrile seizures are benign. Antipyretics for comfort only (do not prevent recurrence).
2. Refer if complex, prolonged (>15 min), focal, or recurrent in same illness. Exclude meningitis. NICE NG143, CKS.

options.label: Management & referral
options.guidance:
MANAGEMENT PLAN:
1. Supportive: fluids, paracetamol/ibuprofen for discomfort. Usually self-limiting.
2. Refer if dehydration, meningism, or immunocompromised. NICE CKS.

options.label: Management & referral
options.guidance:
MANAGEMENT PLAN:
1. Supportive care. Avoid contact with pregnant women (risk of fetal hydrops).
2. Refer if aplastic crisis (e.g. sickle cell), immunocompromised, or pregnancy exposure. NICE CKS.

options.label: Management & referral
options.guidance:
MANAGEMENT PLAN:
1. Supportive; notify public health. Vitamin A in areas of deficiency or severe disease.
2. Refer if complications: encephalitis, pneumonia, severe dehydration. MMR for prevention. NICE CKS.

options.label: Management & referral
options.guidance:
MANAGEMENT PLAN:
1. Supportive: analgesia, fluids. Notify public health. Avoid contact with non-immune.
2. Refer if meningoencephalitis, orchitis (supportive + consider analgesia), pancreatitis. MMR for prevention. NICE CKS.

options.label: Management & referral
options.guidance:
MANAGEMENT PLAN:
1. Supportive. Notify if confirmed. Avoid contact with pregnant women.
2. Refer if congenital exposure in pregnancy. MMR for prevention. NICE CKS.

options.label: Management & referral
options.guidance:
MANAGEMENT PLAN:
1. Most viral rashes: supportive. Exclude meningococcal (non-blanching, unwell), Kawasaki, HSP.
2. Safety-net: Traffic light (NG143). Refer if non-blanching, fever + unwell, or diagnostic uncertainty. NICE NG143, CKS.

options.label: Management & referral
options.guidance:
MANAGEMENT PLAN:
1. Mebendazole 100 mg single dose (repeat at 2 weeks if reinfection). Treat whole household. Hygiene: handwashing, wash sleepwear/bedding.
2. Avoid in pregnancy (hygiene measures only). NICE CKS.

options.label: Management & referral
options.guidance:
MANAGEMENT PLAN:
1. Wet combing with conditioner (4 sessions over 2 weeks) or dimeticone 4% lotion (leave 8 h, repeat at 7–9 days). Avoid malathion in asthma.
2. Check household contacts; treat if live lice found. NICE CKS.

options.label: Management & referral
options.guidance:
MANAGEMENT PLAN:
1. Nocturnal: Enuresis alarm first-line; desmopressin if alarm not suitable or for short-term (e.g. sleepover). Reward systems.
2. Daytime wetting: Exclude UTI/constipation; bladder diary; timed voiding. Refer if persistent or red flags. NICE NG111, CKS.

options.label: Management & referral
options.guidance:
MANAGEMENT PLAN:
1. Treat constipation first: macrogol; adequate fluid/fibre; toileting routine. Disimpaction if faecal loading.
2. Refer if treatment failure, soiling with no constipation, or behavioural/psychological concerns. NICE CKS.

options.label: Management & referral
options.guidance:
MANAGEMENT PLAN:
1. Plot height/weight on centiles; assess growth velocity. Exclude chronic disease, hypothyroidism.
2. Refer if height <0.4th centile, growth velocity poor, or delayed puberty. NICE NG11, CKS.

options.label: Management & referral
options.guidance:
MANAGEMENT PLAN:
1. Assess: bone age, FSH/LH, oestradiol/testosterone, prolactin. Exclude chronic disease, underweight.
2. Refer paediatric endocrinology if no signs by 14 (boys) or 13 (girls), or constitutional delay needing support. NICE CKS.

options.label: Management & referral
options.guidance:
MANAGEMENT PLAN:
1. Urgent paediatric endocrinology referral: puberty before 8 (girls) or 9 (boys). LH/FSH, oestradiol/testosterone, bone age, pelvic USS (girls).
2. Treat underlying cause; GnRH analogue if central precocious puberty. NICE CKS.

options.label: Management & referral
options.guidance:
MANAGEMENT PLAN:
1. Innocent murmur: soft, systolic, varies with position, no other signs. Reassure; no echo needed.
2. Refer if symptomatic, diastolic, harsh, or uncertain. Echo for suspected structural. NICE CKS.

options.label: Management & referral
options.guidance:
MANAGEMENT PLAN:
1. Emergency: stridor, drooling, toxic. Do not examine throat. 999; senior anaesthetics/ENT. Keep child calm; oxygen if needed.
2. Now rare (HiB vaccine). IV antibiotics after secure airway. NICE CKS.

options.label: Management
options.guidance:
MANAGEMENT PLAN:
1. Contacts: macrolide (azithromycin or clarithromycin) for close contacts to reduce spread, especially household with infant <6 months or pregnant. Notify public health. NICE CKS, UKHSA.

options.label: Management & referral
options.guidance:
MANAGEMENT PLAN:
1. Notify public health. Macrolide (e.g. azithromycin) if <21 days of cough to reduce spread; may not change course. Supportive for paroxysms.
2. Refer if infant <6 months, severe paroxysms, or complications. NICE CKS.

options.label: Management
options.guidance:
MANAGEMENT PLAN:
1. Close contacts: offer chemoprophylaxis (ciprofloxacin or rifampicin) per UKHSA. Vaccination for serogroup C/B as appropriate. Notify public health. NICE CKS, UKHSA.

options.label: Management & referral
options.guidance:
MANAGEMENT PLAN:
1. Barrier cream (e.g. zinc); frequent nappy changes; air time. If candida (satellite lesions): add topical antifungal (e.g. clotrimazole).
2. Refer if severe, infected, or not improving. NICE CKS.

options.label: Management & referral
options.guidance:
MANAGEMENT PLAN:
1. History and exclusion diet or IgE/skin test as appropriate. Avoid allergen; adrenaline auto-injector if anaphylaxis risk.
2. Refer if severe reaction, multiple allergies, or diagnostic uncertainty. NICE CG116, CKS.

options.label: Management & referral
options.guidance:
MANAGEMENT PLAN:
1. Emollients; topical steroid for eczema flares. Step up if uncontrolled. Consider allergy testing if food/trigger suspected.
2. Refer if severe eczema, failure of topical therapy, or need for systemic. NICE NG80, CKS.

options.label: Management & referral
options.guidance:
MANAGEMENT PLAN:
1. Parenting strategies; behavioural interventions. Rule out ADHD, anxiety, learning difficulty.
2. Refer if severe, family crisis, or suspected conduct disorder. NICE NG158, CKS.

options.label: Management & referral
options.guidance:
MANAGEMENT PLAN:
1. Assess reading/spelling; exclude vision/hearing. Educational support and reasonable adjustments.
2. Refer for formal assessment if needed for exam access or EHCP. NICE CKS.

options.label: Management & referral
options.guidance:
MANAGEMENT PLAN:
1. Hearing test; assess language and social communication. Early intervention (SLT) if delayed.
2. Refer if red flags (regression, no words by 18 months), or for autism assessment if indicated. NICE NG128, CKS.

options.label: Management & referral
options.guidance:
MANAGEMENT PLAN:
1. Sleep hygiene: routine, consistent bedtime, limit screens. Behavioural strategies (controlled crying, gradual retreat) if appropriate.
2. Refer if sleep disorder suspected, OSA, or significant family impact. NICE CKS.

options.label: Management & referral
options.guidance:
MANAGEMENT PLAN:
1. Exclude red flags (weight loss, nocturnal pain, family history IBD). Reassurance; dietary review; stress/school.
2. Refer if red flags, persistent, or diagnostic uncertainty. NICE NG11, CKS.

options.label: Management & referral
options.guidance:
MANAGEMENT PLAN:
1. Newborn blood spot includes CF screening. If positive/screen positive: refer for sweat test and genetics.
2. Support family; ensure follow-up at CF centre. NICE CKS.

options.label: Management & referral
options.guidance:
MANAGEMENT PLAN:
1. Use NICE threshold graphs (gestational age, hours of life). Phototherapy or exchange if above threshold.
2. Refer if conjugated jaundice, prolonged, or unwell. Check TFTs if prolonged. NICE CG98, CKS.

options.label: Management & referral
options.guidance:
MANAGEMENT PLAN:
1. Use Green Book schedule; give at minimum intervals (4 weeks for inactivated; no need to restart). MMR, pre-school booster, HPV, MenACWY as per schedule.
2. Refer to immunisation clinic if complex or travel. NICE CKS, Green Book.

options.label: Management & referral
options.guidance:
MANAGEMENT PLAN:
1. Suspect: persistent joint swelling, morning stiffness, limp. Urgent paediatric rheumatology referral. NSAIDs for symptom relief.
2. DMARDs/biologics as per paediatric rheumatology. NICE CKS.

options.label: Management & referral
options.guidance:
MANAGEMENT PLAN:
1. Refer paediatric surgery/urology by 6 months (corrected for prematurity). Orchidopexy usually by 12–18 months.
2. Do not confuse with retractile testes (reducible to scrotum). NICE NG11, CKS.

options.label: Assessment & triage
options.guidance:
MANAGEMENT PLAN:
1. Traffic light (NG143). Exclude meningococcal (non-blanching, unwell). Consider viral exanthem, Kawasaki, HSP, chickenpox, measles.
2. Supportive for most viral; refer if non-blanching, fever + unwell, or diagnostic uncertainty. NICE NG143, CKS.

options.label: Infection / rash
options.guidance:
MANAGEMENT PLAN:
1. Chickenpox/measles/mumps/rubella: supportive. Kawasaki: refer. Febrile convulsion: reassure. Hand foot mouth/slapped cheek: supportive. NICE NG143, CKS.

options.label: Development / growth / surgical
options.guidance:
MANAGEMENT PLAN:
1. Enuresis: alarm; desmopressin if needed. Short stature: plot; refer if faltering. Circumcision/phimosis/hypospadias: refer. NICE NG11, NG111, CKS.

options.label: Threadworms
options.guidance:
MANAGEMENT PLAN:
1. Mebendazole 100 mg single dose (repeat at 2 weeks if reinfection). Hygiene: handwashing, wash sleepwear/bedding; treat whole household. NICE CKS.

options.label: Head lice
options.guidance:
MANAGEMENT PLAN:
1. Wet combing with conditioner (4 sessions over 2 weeks) or dimeticone 4% lotion (leave 8 h, repeat at 7–9 days). Avoid malathion in asthma. NICE CKS.

options.label: Croup
options.guidance:
MANAGEMENT PLAN:
1. Mild: Single dose dexamethasone 0.15 mg/kg (max 10 mg) PO. Moderate/severe: same + consider nebulised adrenaline; admit if stridor at rest, hypoxia, or poor fluid intake. NICE CKS.

options.label: HIV / TB / viral
options.guidance:
MANAGEMENT PLAN:
1. HIV: test; PrEP/PEP per NICE. TB: refer TB service; RIPE. COVID antiviral: per eligibility. Shingles: aciclovir if <72 h; 2WW if ophthalmic. NICE NG33, NG122, CKS.

options.label: Bites / travel / other
options.guidance:
MANAGEMENT PLAN:
1. Bite: clean; antibiotic if high risk; rabies/tetanus. Needlestick: risk assess; PEP if source high risk. Travel: advise vaccines; malaria prophylaxis. NICE CKS.

options.label: Tick bite / Lyme
options.guidance:
MANAGEMENT PLAN:
1. Remove tick with fine-tipped tweezers. Prophylaxis: doxycycline 200 mg single dose if attached ≥36 h and endemic area. Erythema migrans: doxycycline 100 mg bd 21 days. Refer if neurological/joint. NICE NG95, CKS.

options.label: Needlestick / sharps
options.guidance:
MANAGEMENT PLAN:
1. Wash; encourage bleeding. Risk assess: source HIV/HBV/HCV status. HBV: check immunity; offer vaccine/immunoglobulin. HIV: PEP within 72 h per local protocol. Baseline bloods; follow-up. NICE NG33, CKS.

options.label: Cranial nerve / headache
options.guidance:
MANAGEMENT PLAN:
1. Bell's palsy: steroid within 72 h; eye care. Trigeminal neuralgia: carbamazepine. 2WW: brain tumour. SAH: emergency. NICE NG150, NG12, CKS.

options.label: Neuropathy / neuromuscular
options.guidance:
MANAGEMENT PLAN:
1. Peripheral neuropathy: exclude B12, diabetes; refer if cause unclear. Myasthenia gravis: refer. MND: refer. NICE CKS.

options.label: Anaemia / clotting
options.guidance:
MANAGEMENT PLAN:
1. Iron: oral first; IV if intolerant or urgent. Folate: replace; exclude B12. Anticoagulation: DOAC per NICE NG196. Warfarin: INR target; reversal per guidance. NICE NG24, NG196.

options.label: Malignancy / cytopenia
options.guidance:
MANAGEMENT PLAN:
1. 2WW: unexplained cytopenia, lymphadenopathy, suspected lymphoma/leukaemia. Thrombosis: exclude malignancy. MGUS: monitor or refer. NICE NG12, NG24.

options.label: Ear / hearing
options.guidance:
MANAGEMENT PLAN:
1. Glue ear: watch or refer. Cholesteatoma: refer. Otosclerosis: refer. Presbyacusis: hearing aid. Foreign body: refer if impacted. NICE CKS.

options.label: Nose / throat / 2WW
options.guidance:
MANAGEMENT PLAN:
1. Nasal polyps: topical steroid; refer if obstructing. Quinsy: admit. 2WW: hoarseness >3 weeks, oral cancer. Recurrent tonsillitis: refer per criteria. NICE NG12, CKS.

options.label: Assessment
options.guidance:
MANAGEMENT PLAN:
1. Altitude: assess AMS risk; advise gradual ascent; consider acetazolamide for prophylaxis. Expedition: pre-travel health, kit, evacuation. NICE CKS Travel.

options.label: When to refer
options.guidance:
MANAGEMENT PLAN:
1. Severe AMS/HACE/HAPE: descent and evacuation. Travel clinic for complex itineraries. NICE CKS.

options.label: Pre-departure
options.guidance:
MANAGEMENT PLAN:
1. Risk assessment; vaccinations; kit; first aid; evacuation plan. Consider travel insurance and remote medical support. NICE CKS.

options.label: Referral
options.guidance:
MANAGEMENT PLAN:
1. Travel clinic for complex destinations. Occupational health if work-related. NICE CKS.

1. Refer anaesthetics/pre-op clinic if high risk or unclear fitness. NICE NG45.

1. Exclude drugs (spironolactone, cimetidine, cannabis, etc.), liver disease, hypogonadism. Examine for testicular mass. NICE CKS.

options.label: Referral
options.guidance:
MANAGEMENT PLAN:
1. Refer if unilateral, hard mass, or concern. Endocrinology if biochemical cause. NICE CKS.

MANAGEMENT PLAN:
1. History of tool use; vascular/neurological symptoms. Consider referral for formal assessment. NICE CKS.

options.label: Management

1. Reduce exposure; warm gloves; smoking cessation. Refer occupational health. NICE CKS.

options.guidance:
MANAGEMENT PLAN:
1. CRP/ESR: support diagnosis or monitor known inflammatory condition. Do not use alone to exclude serious disease. NICE CKS.

options.guidance:
MANAGEMENT PLAN:
1. Interpret with history and examination. 2WW if cancer suspected per NG12. NICE CKS.

options.label: Assessment
options.guidance:
MANAGEMENT PLAN:
1. BMI, waist; comorbidities. Set target. Behaviour change; diet and activity. NICE CG189, CKS.

options.label: Pharmacotherapy / referral
options.guidance:
MANAGEMENT PLAN:
1. Consider orlistat or GLP-1 if criteria met. Refer bariatric if BMI ≥40 or ≥35 with comorbidity. NICE CG189.

cancer in the primary care setting

options.label: Support
options.guidance:
MANAGEMENT PLAN:
1. Holistic needs; coordination with oncology; palliative care when appropriate. NICE NG12, CKS.

options.label: 2WW / referral
options.guidance:
MANAGEMENT PLAN:
1. Suspected cancer: refer per NG12. Support during diagnosis and treatment. NICE NG12.

options.label: Assessment
options.guidance:
MANAGEMENT PLAN:
1. Review drugs (antipsychotics, antidepressants, domperidone, etc.). ECG if risk. NICE CKS.

options.label: Management
options.guidance:
MANAGEMENT PLAN:
1. Stop or switch QT-prolonging drug if possible. Monitor ECG. Avoid combination of prolonging drugs. NICE CKS.

options.label: Assessment
options.guidance:
MANAGEMENT PLAN:
1. Short-term only; prefer paracetamol/NSAID. Assess dependence risk. NICE NG59, CKS.

options.label: Deprescribing
options.guidance:
MANAGEMENT PLAN:
1. Taper gradually; treat withdrawal if needed. Multimodal pain management. NICE CKS.

options.label: Assessment
options.guidance:
MANAGEMENT PLAN:
1. Rotterdam criteria; exclude thyroid, prolactin, NCAH. NICE NG38, CKS.

options.label: Management
options.guidance:
MANAGEMENT PLAN:
1. Lifestyle; metformin if metabolic need; COCP for cycle/androgen; fertility referral if trying to conceive. NICE NG38.

options.label: Assessment
options.guidance:
MANAGEMENT PLAN:
1. Check ferritin; treat iron deficiency. Review drugs (antidepressants, antihistamines). NICE CKS.

options.label: Treatment
options.guidance:

1. Dopamine agonist (ropinirole/pramipexole) or gabapentinoid. Low dose; augment with iron if low. NICE CKS.

options.label: Immediate

1. Safeguarding; consent for forensic examination; STI prophylaxis; emergency contraception; psychological first aid. NICE NG76, CKS.

options.label: Referral
options.guidance:
MANAGEMENT PLAN:
1. Sexual Assault Referral Centre (SARC); mental health; follow-up. NICE CKS.

options.label: Assessment
options.guidance:
MANAGEMENT PLAN:
1. Insomnia: sleep hygiene; CBT-i first-line. Exclude OSA, RLS, psychiatric cause. NICE NG215, CKS.

options.label: Referral
options.guidance:
MANAGEMENT PLAN:
1. Sleep study if OSA suspected. Refer sleep clinic if refractory. NICE CKS.

keywords: superficial venous thrombosis in primary care

options.label: Assessment
options.guidance:
MANAGEMENT PLAN:
1. Differentiate from DVT (Wells, D-dimer if needed). If near saphenofemoral junction consider anticoagulation. NICE NG158, CKS.

options.label: Management
options.guidance:
MANAGEMENT PLAN:
1. NSAID or topical; consider prophylactic dose LMWH if extensive or high risk. NICE CKS.

options.label: Suspected GCA
options.guidance:
MANAGEMENT PLAN:
1. Urgent high-dose steroid (e.g. prednisolone 40–60 mg); same-day CRP/ESR; refer ophthalmology if visual symptoms. Do not delay steroid for biopsy. NICE NG210.

options.label: Follow-up
options.guidance:
MANAGEMENT PLAN:
1. Taper steroid; bone protection. Monitor relapse. NICE NG210, CKS.

options.label: Smoking cessation
options.guidance:
MANAGEMENT PLAN:
1. E-cigarettes can support quit attempt. Weigh benefits vs unknown long-term risk. NICE NG209, CKS.

options.label: Safety-net
options.guidance:
MANAGEMENT PLAN:
1. Report adverse effects via Yellow Card. Avoid in pregnancy if possible. NICE CKS.

options.label: Learning resource
options.guidance:
MANAGEMENT PLAN:
1. Use for CPD on communication and person-centred care. Apply to consultations. No specific patient pathway.

options.label: Practice
options.guidance:
MANAGEMENT PLAN:
1. Equitable access to screening and 2WW; address barriers; culturally sensitive communication. NICE NG12, CKS.

options.label: Learning resource
options.guidance:

1. Use for CPD. Apply NICE CKS and NG23 (menopause), contraception, gynae guidelines. No single pathway.

options.label: Management & referral
options.guidance:
MANAGEMENT PLAN:
1. Safety first: assess immediate risk; respect confidentiality but explain limits (safeguarding, risk to others). Do not investigate alone.
2. Document findings; refer to specialist (IDVA, refuge, social care) per local pathway. Offer follow-up. NICE PH50, NG76, CKS.

options.label: Management
options.guidance:
MANAGEMENT PLAN:
1. Multifactorial assessment: medication review (sedatives, hypotensives), vision, footwear, home hazards, strength/balance. Treat osteoporosis if fracture risk.
2. Exercise (strength and balance); vitamin D; address orthostatic hypotension. NICE CG161, NG231, CKS.

options.label: Principles
options.guidance:
MANAGEMENT PLAN:
1. Review indication, benefit vs harm; involve patient. Stop one drug at a time; taper where needed (e.g. benzodiazepines, antihypertensives).
2. PPI: trial dose reduction/stop if no ongoing indication. Statin: consider in frailty/life-limiting illness. Antihypertensive: reduce if hypotension/falls. Antipsychotic: taper slowly; monitor. NICE NG215, CKS, deprescribing.org.

options.label: CGA & intervention
options.guidance:
MANAGEMENT PLAN:
1. Comprehensive geriatric assessment (CGA): function, cognition, mood, medication, nutrition. Identify reversible causes.
2. Intervention: medication review; strength/balance; advance care planning; treat osteoporosis. NICE NG161, CKS.

options.label: MUST & management
options.guidance:
MANAGEMENT PLAN:
1. Screen: MUST (or equivalent); weight/BMI trend. Treat cause (dysphagia, illness, social).
2. Oral nutritional supplements if dietary advice insufficient; refer if severe or complex. NICE NG69, CKS.

options.label: Structured review
options.guidance:
MANAGEMENT PLAN:
1. Indication for each drug; check interactions, renal/hepatic dose. STOPP/START or equivalent. Deprescribe where benefit unclear.
2. Patient understanding; adherence; monitoring. NICE NG5, NG114, NG67, CKS.

options.label: Management
options.guidance:
MANAGEMENT PLAN:
1. Resistance exercise (strength training); adequate protein intake. Treat underlying cause (malnutrition, inactivity).
2. Vitamin D if deficient. Consider osteoporosis assessment. NICE NG231, CKS.

options.label: Management
options.guidance:
MANAGEMENT PLAN:
1. Treat underlying disease; nutritional support (dietitian). Screen for reversible causes (e.g. dysphagia, depression).
2. Consider oral supplements; avoid forced feeding in advanced illness. Palliative approach if appropriate. NICE NG69, CKS.

options.label: Pre-travel
options.guidance:
MANAGEMENT PLAN:
1. Vaccinations per destination (NaTHNaC); malaria chemoprophylaxis if indicated. Altitude: gradual ascent; acetazolamide if AMS risk. Diving: fitness to dive.
2. Travellers' diarrhoea: hygiene; loperamide/antibiotic for use abroad. NICE CKS Travel, NaTHNaC.

options.label: Replacement
options.guidance:
MANAGEMENT PLAN:
1. Confirm deficiency; treat cause. Magnesium: replace orally (e.g. magnesium glycerophosphate). Vitamin C: dietary + supplement if deficient. Vitamin K: phytonadione if bleeding/anticoagulant reversal. Zinc: oral replacement. Multiple: address diet; replace as per levels. NICE CKS, BNF.

options.label: Assessment & management
options.guidance:
MANAGEMENT PLAN:
1. Assess cause (dehydration vs fluid overload). Encourage oral fluids; consider IV if severe or unable to drink.
2. In elderly: avoid dehydration; monitor in heat/c illness. CKS.

options.label: Approach
options.guidance:
MANAGEMENT PLAN:
1. Register as temp/fully; offer health screening (TB, blood-borne viruses, mental health, immunisation). Address barriers to access.
2. Safeguarding; signpost to housing/support. RCGP, GOV.UK, NICE.

options.label: Review & safety
options.guidance:
MANAGEMENT PLAN:
